tests.name: npm install resolves the ignore package and tsc --noEmit stays clean

reported.evidence: package.json:51 lists "ignore": "^7.0.14"; npm install succeeded; npx tsc --noEmit produced no output

tasks.note: the gate ran no test: every named test of this Task was reported by the builder

cases.title: ac1: an anchored rule excludes the top-level directory it names, not a same-named directory deeper in the tree
error path: a broken .git directory degrades the tracked-file override to empty, not a throw
ac2: a tracked directory named 'target' (an old built-in bare name) not matched by any ignore rule is included
ac3: a subdirectory .gitignore rule scopes to that subdirectory, excluding a same-named file elsewhere in the tree
ac9 baseline: a non-git folder with no ignore files includes every file (only the built-ins apply)
a non-git folder with an ignore file is filtered by its rules alone (ac9)
a tracked file under .insrc is excluded (built-in override, even over the tracked-file union)
listFiles() returns exactly the included files
